import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import svd, svdvals, eigvals
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits

np.set_printoptions(precision=4, suppress=True, linewidth=180)
def center_columns(a):
    return a - a.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)

with threadpool_limits(limits=2):
    A, B = {}, {}
    for l in range(4):
        g = W[f"ln1_w.{l}"].astype(float)
        b = W[f"ln1_b.{l}"].astype(float)
        for j in range(6):
            sl = slice(64*j, 64*(j+1))
            q = W[f"W_q.{l}"][sl].astype(float)
            k = W[f"W_k.{l}"][sl].astype(float)
            v = W[f"W_v.{l}"][sl].astype(float)
            o = W[f"W_o.{l}"][:,sl].astype(float)
            qg, kg, vg = [center_columns(z*g) for z in (q,k,v)]
            a, ov = qg.T @ kg / 8, o @ vg
            A[l,j], B[l,j] = a, ov
            s = svdvals(a)
            ev = eigvals(a)
            ev = ev[np.argsort(abs(ev))[::-1]][:10]
            key_bias = kg.T @ (q @ b) / 8
            query_bias = qg.T @ (k @ b) / 8
            print(f"L{l}H{j}: scaled_QK fro={np.linalg.norm(a):.4f} top={np.round(s[:6],4)} "
                  f"trace={np.trace(a):.4f} key_bias_norm={np.linalg.norm(key_bias):.4f} query_bias_norm={np.linalg.norm(query_bias):.4f}")
            print("  QK eigenvalues:", np.round(ev,4))

    print("\nCross-layer product alignment: tr(QK_later OV_earlier)/(||QK||_F ||OV||_F)")
    print("For each later head, the 5 largest positive alignments and the largest negative alignment.")
    for (l,j), a in A.items():
        if l == 0:
            continue
        scores = []
        for (m,h), ov in B.items():
            if m < l:
                score = np.trace(a @ ov)/(np.linalg.norm(a)*np.linalg.norm(ov))
                scores.append((float(score), f"L{m}H{h}"))
        scores.sort(reverse=True)
        print(f"L{l}H{j}: positive={[(n,round(s,4)) for s,n in scores[:5]]}; minimum={scores[-1]}")

    print("\nFirst-layer singular-value profiles")
    for j in range(6):
        sl = slice(64*j,64*(j+1))
        for name in ("W_q","W_k","W_v"):
            z = W[f"{name}.0"][sl].astype(float)
            s = svdvals(center_columns(z*W["ln1_w.0"]))
            print(f"L0H{j} {name}: {np.round(s[:40],3)}")

    print("\nFirst-layer subspace overlap")
    q = center_columns(W["W_q.0"][128:192].astype(float)*W["ln1_w.0"])
    k = center_columns(W["W_k.0"][128:192].astype(float)*W["ln1_w.0"])
    _,s,vt = svd(np.concatenate([q,k]), full_matrices=False)
    p = vt[:32].T
    print("Candidate positional joint Q/K spectrum:",np.round(s[:50],3))
    for l in range(4):
        for j in range(6):
            a=A[l,j]
            total=np.linalg.norm(a)**2
            pp=np.linalg.norm(p.T@a@p)**2/total
            left=np.linalg.norm(p.T@a)**2/total
            right=np.linalg.norm(a@p)**2/total
            print(f"L{l}H{j}: candidate_position_energy QQ={left:.3f} KK={right:.3f} QK={pp:.3f}")

import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import svd, svdvals
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits

np.set_printoptions(precision=3, suppress=True, linewidth=190)
with threadpool_limits(limits=2):
    print("Longer singular-value profiles")
    for name in ("W_v.0", "W_fc.0", "W_proj.0", "W_fc.3", "W_proj.3"):
        s = svdvals(W[name].astype(float))
        print(name, np.round(s[:80],3))

    sl = slice(128,192)
    v = W["W_v.0"][sl].astype(float)
    o = W["W_o.0"][:,sl].astype(float)
    _,sv,vt = svd(v, full_matrices=False)
    print("\nL0H2 unscaled V singular values:", np.round(sv,3))
    t = vt[:27].T
    f = W["W_fc.0"].astype(float)*W["ln2_w.0"]
    f -= f.mean(axis=1,keepdims=True)
    b = o @ (v*W["ln1_w.0"])
    b -= b.mean(axis=1,keepdims=True)
    direct = f @ t
    previous = f @ b @ t
    print("Direct readout singular values:",np.round(svdvals(direct),3))
    print("OV-composed readout singular values:",np.round(svdvals(previous),3))

    def whiten_columns(z, keep):
        u,s,vt=svd(z-z.mean(0),full_matrices=False)
        return u[:,:keep]*np.sqrt(len(z)),s

    direct_z,_=whiten_columns(direct,24)
    previous_z,_=whiten_columns(previous,24)
    for label,z in (("direct",direct_z),("OV-composed",previous_z)):
        z=z/np.maximum(np.linalg.norm(z,axis=1,keepdims=True),1e-12)
        print("\n",label,"neuron-direction clustering")
        for nc in (16,20,24,28,32,40):
            fit=KMeans(n_clusters=nc,n_init=10,random_state=1).fit(z)
            counts=np.bincount(fit.labels_)
            cos=np.sum(z*fit.cluster_centers_[fit.labels_],axis=1)/np.maximum(np.linalg.norm(fit.cluster_centers_[fit.labels_],axis=1),1e-12)
            print(f"k={nc}: mean_cos={cos.mean():.3f}, median_cos={np.median(cos):.3f}, counts={sorted(counts.tolist(),reverse=True)}")

    print("\nFirst-layer MLP row alignment with its own output columns")
    fc=W["W_fc.0"].astype(float)
    proj=W["W_proj.0"].astype(float).T
    cos=np.sum(fc*proj,axis=1)/(np.linalg.norm(fc,axis=1)*np.linalg.norm(proj,axis=1))
    print("cosine percentiles:",np.percentile(cos,[0,10,25,50,75,90,100]))
    print("Effective LN-scaled first MLP column energy, largest 30 coordinates:")
    e=np.linalg.norm(f,axis=0)
    ix=np.argsort(e)[-30:][::-1]
    print(list(zip(ix.tolist(),np.round(e[ix],3).tolist())))

import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import svd, svdvals, eigvalsh
from scipy.stats import skew, kurtosis
from sklearn.decomposition import FastICA
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits
import warnings

np.set_printoptions(precision=3, suppress=True, linewidth=180)
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore", category=UserWarning)

with threadpool_limits(limits=2):
    A,B={},{}
    for l in range(4):
        g=W[f"ln1_w.{l}"].astype(float)
        for j in range(6):
            sl=slice(64*j,64*(j+1))
            q=W[f"W_q.{l}"][sl].astype(float)*g
            k=W[f"W_k.{l}"][sl].astype(float)*g
            v=W[f"W_v.{l}"][sl].astype(float)*g
            q-=q.mean(1,keepdims=True)
            k-=k.mean(1,keepdims=True)
            v-=v.mean(1,keepdims=True)
            A[l,j]=q.T@k/8
            B[l,j]=W[f"W_o.{l}"][:,sl].astype(float)@v

    print("Within-layer QK Frobenius cosines")
    for l in range(4):
        z=np.stack([A[l,j].ravel()/np.linalg.norm(A[l,j]) for j in range(6)])
        print("Layer",l,"\n",z@z.T)

    print("\nFirst-layer OV products: singular values and output-subspace overlaps")
    bases={}
    for j in range(6):
        u,s,vt=svd(B[0,j],full_matrices=False)
        bases[j]=u[:,:3]
        print(f"L0H{j}: scaled OV singular values {s[:12]}")
    for j in range(6):
        print(f"L0H{j} top3 output overlap:",[round(np.linalg.norm(bases[j].T@bases[h])**2/3,3) for h in range(6)])

    print("\nLater QK energy on first-layer broad-head output span")
    u,s,vt=svd(np.concatenate([B[0,j] for j in (0,1,4,5)],axis=1),full_matrices=False)
    print("Joint OV singular values:",s[:20])
    p=u[:,:4]
    for l in range(1,4):
        for j in range(6):
            a=A[l,j]
            z=np.linalg.norm(a)**2
            print(f"L{l}H{j}: query={np.linalg.norm(p.T@a)**2/z:.3f}, key={np.linalg.norm(a@p)**2/z:.3f}, both={np.linalg.norm(p.T@a@p)**2/z:.3f}")

    print("\nDirect previous-head composition diagnostics")
    for l in range(1,4):
        for j in range(6):
            c=A[l,j]@B[0,2]
            sy=(c+c.T)/2
            e=eigvalsh(sy)
            pos=np.sum(e[e>0]**2)/np.sum(e**2)
            print(f"L{l}H{j}: trace={np.trace(c):.3f}, symmetric_positive_energy={pos:.3f}, top_sym_eigenvalues={e[-4:]}")

    print("\nICA of first MLP weight-row coordinates, not activations")
    _,s,vt=svd(W["W_v.0"][128:192].astype(float),full_matrices=False)
    t=vt[:24].T
    f=W["W_fc.0"].astype(float)*W["ln2_w.0"]
    f-=f.mean(1,keepdims=True)
    d=f@t
    p=f@B[0,2]@t
    d=d/np.linalg.norm(d)*np.sqrt(d.size)
    p=p/np.linalg.norm(p)*np.sqrt(p.size)
    z=np.concatenate([d,p])
    ica=FastICA(n_components=24,random_state=1,whiten="unit-variance",max_iter=3000,tol=0.0005)
    c=ica.fit_transform(z)
    sign=np.where(skew(c,axis=0)>=0,1.,-1.)
    c*=sign
    print("ICA component excess kurtosis:",np.round(kurtosis(c,axis=0),2))
    print("ICA component skewness:",np.round(skew(c,axis=0),2))
    corr=np.corrcoef(c[:1536].T,c[1536:].T)[:24,24:]
    print("Same-component direct/OV-composed coefficient correlations:",np.round(np.diag(corr),3))
    print("Largest cross-component coefficient correlations:")
    pairs=[(corr[i,j],i,j) for i in range(24) for j in range(24) if i!=j]
    print(sorted(pairs,reverse=True)[:25])

import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import svd, svdvals
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits

np.set_printoptions(precision=3, suppress=True, linewidth=190)
with threadpool_limits(limits=2):
    fc=W["W_fc.0"].astype(float)
    out=W["W_proj.0"].astype(float).T
    fn=np.linalg.norm(fc,axis=1)
    on=np.linalg.norm(out,axis=1)
    cos=np.sum(fc*out,axis=1)/(fn*on)
    ix=np.argsort(fn)[::-1]
    print("First MLP input-row norm percentiles:",np.percentile(fn,[0,25,50,75,90,95,98,99,100]))
    print("Top 60 first MLP input rows: neuron, input norm, output norm, input/output cosine")
    for i in ix[:60]:
        print(int(i),round(fn[i],3),round(on[i],3),round(cos[i],3))

    print("\nMost anti-aligned first MLP neurons:")
    neg=np.argsort(cos)[:35]
    print([(int(i),round(cos[i],3),round(fn[i],3),round(on[i],3)) for i in neg])
    z=fc[ix[:32]]/fn[ix[:32],None]
    gram=z@z.T
    print("Top-row pairwise cosine percentiles:",np.percentile(gram[np.triu_indices(32,1)],[0,10,25,50,75,90,100]))
    print("Singular values of normalized top32 rows:",svdvals(z))

    print("\nL0H2 positional query/key row-space relation")
    q=W["W_q.0"][128:192].astype(float)*W["ln1_w.0"]
    k=W["W_k.0"][128:192].astype(float)*W["ln1_w.0"]
    q-=q.mean(1,keepdims=True)
    k-=k.mean(1,keepdims=True)
    _,s,vt=svd(np.concatenate([q,k]),full_matrices=False)
    p=vt[:24].T
    metric=(p.T@(q.T@q+k.T@k)@p)/2
    e,u=np.linalg.eigh(metric)
    whitening=u@np.diag(1/np.sqrt(e))@u.T
    a=whitening@(p.T@q.T@k@p)@whitening
    u,s,vt=svd(a,full_matrices=False)
    rotation=u@vt
    ev=np.linalg.eigvals(rotation)
    print("Whitened QK singular values:",s)
    print("Rotation eigenvalue phases:",np.sort(np.angle(ev)))
    print("Other first-layer QK products expressed against powers of this weight-derived rotation")
    powers={r:np.linalg.matrix_power(rotation,r) for r in range(-6,7)}
    for j in range(6):
        sl=slice(64*j,64*(j+1))
        qj=W["W_q.0"][sl].astype(float)*W["ln1_w.0"]
        kj=W["W_k.0"][sl].astype(float)*W["ln1_w.0"]
        qj-=qj.mean(1,keepdims=True)
        kj-=kj.mean(1,keepdims=True)
        aj=whitening@(p.T@qj.T@kj@p)@whitening
        scores=[np.sum(aj*powers[r])/(np.linalg.norm(aj)*np.linalg.norm(powers[r])) for r in range(-6,7)]
        print(f"L0H{j} cosines for powers -6..6:",np.round(scores,3))

import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import svd, svdvals, eigvalsh
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits

np.set_printoptions(precision=4, suppress=True, linewidth=180)
with threadpool_limits(limits=2):
    A,B,Kbias={},{},{}
    for l in range(4):
        g=W[f"ln1_w.{l}"].astype(float)
        bias=W[f"ln1_b.{l}"].astype(float)
        for j in range(6):
            sl=slice(64*j,64*(j+1))
            qr=W[f"W_q.{l}"][sl].astype(float)
            kr=W[f"W_k.{l}"][sl].astype(float)
            q,k,v=[z*g for z in (qr,kr,W[f"W_v.{l}"][sl].astype(float))]
            q-=q.mean(1,keepdims=True)
            k-=k.mean(1,keepdims=True)
            v-=v.mean(1,keepdims=True)
            A[l,j]=q.T@k/8
            B[l,j]=W[f"W_o.{l}"][:,sl].astype(float)@v
            Kbias[l,j]=k.T@(qr@bias)/8

    u,s,vt=svd(np.concatenate([B[0,j] for j in (0,1,4,5)],axis=1),full_matrices=False)
    p=u[:,:4]
    template=sum(Kbias[1,j]/np.linalg.norm(Kbias[1,j]) for j in range(6))
    template/=np.linalg.norm(template)
    print("Key-selection bias geometry")
    print("shared-span fraction uses top4 output directions of L0H0/H1/H4/H5")
    for l in range(4):
        for j in range(6):
            b=Kbias[l,j]
            n=np.linalg.norm(b)
            frac=np.linalg.norm(p.T@b)**2/n**2
            print(f"L{l}H{j}: norm={n:.4f}, shared_span_fraction={frac:.3f}, cosine_to_L1_consensus={b@template/n:.3f}")

    _,s,vt=svd(W["W_v.0"][128:192].astype(float),full_matrices=False)
    t=vt[:24].T
    print("\nComposition restricted to top24 input directions of L0H2 V")
    for l in range(1,4):
        for j in range(6):
            c=t.T@A[l,j]@B[0,2]@t
            e=eigvalsh((c+c.T)/2)
            positive=np.sum(e[e>0]**2)/np.sum(e**2)
            tr=np.trace(c)/(np.sqrt(24)*np.linalg.norm(c))
            print(f"L{l}H{j}: normalized_trace={tr:.4f}, positive_symmetric_energy={positive:.4f}, symmetric_eigenvalue_range=({e[0]:.4f},{e[-1]:.4f})")

    print("\nCoordinate-permutation null for L3H1/L0H2 composition alignment")
    a=A[3,1]
    b=B[0,2]
    denom=np.linalg.norm(a)*np.linalg.norm(b)
    observed=np.sum(a*b.T)/denom
    rng=np.random.default_rng(7)
    null=[]
    for _ in range(1000):
        perm=rng.permutation(384)
        bp=b[np.ix_(perm,perm)]
        null.append(np.sum(a*bp.T)/denom)
    null=np.array(null)
    print(f"observed={observed:.5f}, null_mean={null.mean():.5f}, null_sd={null.std():.5f}, null_range=({null.min():.5f},{null.max():.5f})")

    print("\nLast MLP output spectrum energy")
    s=svdvals(W["W_proj.3"].astype(float))
    for r in (16,20,23,24,26,27,28,29,32,40):
        print(f"rank {r}: cumulative_squared_singular_value_fraction={np.sum(s[:r]**2)/np.sum(s**2):.4f}, next_singular_value={s[r]:.4f}")
